name: Aventurine
faction: Interastral Peace Corporation (one of the Ten Stonehearts)
description: Real name Kakavasha, Aventurine is one of the IPC's ten senior executives known as the Ten Stonehearts. The sole survivor of a massacre on his homeworld Sigonia-IV, he endured enslavement before rising through the IPC's ranks, and treats life as a high-risk gamble worth wagering everything on.
